# Mermaid 13, Ahead of Its Release

Version 2.0.0-alpha.1 runs the card on Mermaid 13.0.0-alpha.3, so you can try the next Mermaid on your own dashboards before it is final. It is a pre-release: install it only to test, and expect diagrams to look a little different from 1.x. _[#1]_

## What Mermaid 13 changes on your cards

- **Every diagram type still renders.** All 19 types of the catalog draw on Mermaid 13, in light and dark, with your bindings, state colours, icons and moving edges as before.
- **Some types are laid out differently.** A mind map grows sideways from its root instead of around it, a user journey is drawn larger, and a state diagram may arrange its branches another way. Boxes in flowchart, class, ER and block diagrams are a little smaller and lose their drop shadow. These are Mermaid's own changes, not the card's.
- **The card is smaller.** It shrinks from 5.6 MB to 3.6 MB, and Mermaid still loads only when the first diagram is shown.

## How the card keeps working

- **Bindings find their node by the id Mermaid 13 gives it.** Mermaid 12 left the card to read node ids out of element ids; 13 names every node, cluster, Gantt task, kanban item, pie slice and sankey node directly. Your `entities:` keys stay the same, edge ids like `L_HP_BOIL_0` included.
- **Moving edges move again.** Mermaid 13 marks an edge as fast or slow but no longer animates it, so the card now brings the animation itself, at the same speeds as before, and `speed: auto` works as it did.
- **Icons from Home Assistant show again.** Mermaid 13 drew every `mdi:` icon as a question mark until the card registered its new icons extension.
- **The editor lists your nodes again.** Mermaid 13 removed the parser access the editor used, so it now draws the diagram and offers exactly what a binding can name.

## Fixes

- **A timeline's arrow ends show on a light card again,** an ER diagram's "zero" circles stay hollow on a dark card, and a bound mind map node's underline takes its state colour instead of its section colour.

## If you already have Mermaid Card

To try this version, turn on beta versions for Mermaid Card in HACS and pick 2.0.0-alpha.1; to go back, pick 1.1.3. Your card configs need no change. One thing no longer works on Mermaid 13: a `classDef` that sets an edge's own animation, such as `animation: dash 25s linear infinite`, leaves the edge still. Use `animation: fast` or `slow` on the edge, or `speed: auto` on its binding.
